errors.text: The proposed Al-induced B2 phase is not supported for the specific Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr alloy; the target intervention is 4.2 at.% Cr producing approximately 4 vol.% multicomponent Laves phase.

The density trade-off is internally and physically inconsistent: adding low-density Al should generally reduce alloy density, while ordering or packing changes do not substantiate the claimed marginal density increase.

The experiment varies Al concentration and phase topology simultaneously, so it cannot cleanly distinguish solid-solution hardening from phase-structure strengthening; this requires same-composition, single-phase and phase-bearing states or equivalent controls.
